guidance: Manual teaching evaluation; fixture tests cannot establish rubric quality. Leave not_run until directly observed.

cases.initialMaterial: Published lesson about layer reuse. Prepare a one-point prediction-and-explanation quiz with two essential independent criteria worth 0.5 each before any answer.
cases.startingPrompt: Ask me to predict reuse and explain why, then grade each part.
learnerActions: Inspect the exact saved rubric revision before answering
Give a correct prediction and incorrect causal explanation without assistance
Inspect criterion feedback, evidence and derived total
forbiddenShortcuts: Use one holistic score for independently observable requirements
Change criterion weights after seeing the answer
Call 0.5/1 a pass despite an unmet essential criterion
requiredObservedEvidence: Distinct prediction and reasoning criteria fixed before presentation
Saved learner response and matching criterion evidence refs
0.5/1 total with prediction met and reasoning unmet
Assessment remains unpassed; fresh check preserves prior history
